name: ainra-soak-harness
description: Measure AINRA revocation-propagation latency from >=3 vantage points into an append-only, hash-chained log; render a live status page + a signed tamper-evident soak-report from the REAL measurements. No hardcoded latencies.
comment: A vantage point is a real AINRA verifier (published @ainra/sdk) that polls a registrar and times when a revocation becomes visible. For a real 3-region soak, run one process per region against the registrar's public URL; the report is generated from what each region actually measured.
